originalTitle: 5 Best Dow Stocks to Buy for 2027

content:
Yahoo Finance reported on November 5 that the Dow Jones Industrial Average tumbled 3.4%, or more than 1,800 points, while the S&P 500 fell 4.4% and the Nasdaq Composite sank 5.5% into correction territory. Chip stocks took the brunt of the damage, with AI chip designers and memory makers among the hardest hit. The slide erased the gains from a day earlier, when the Dow had jumped 3% for its best session of 2026 after Democrats won control of both chambers of Congress, Yahoo Finance wrote on November 4. By mid-session Thursday, the index was heading for its worst second day after a midterm election in data going back to 1896, the outlet noted.

For most of the week, the Dow had looked like the sheltered corner of the market. Yahoo Finance reported on November 2 that the Dow edged up 0.4% while the Nasdaq dropped roughly 1% as investors rotated out of technology names and into consumer cyclical and financial services shares, which left the Dow looking like the market's relative winner. On Thursday, that cushion gave way, as the focus turned to what a Democratic Congress could mean for the AI buildout, and for the data centers driving it in particular. You might also be interested in reading our piece on how the AI chip leader's growth compares with the cloud software giant's .

The reversal was fast and violent. Shay Boloor, chief market strategist at an equity research firm, pointed out that the VIX volatility index posted its biggest one-day jump in more than two years. It took the Nasdaq just six minutes on Thursday to erase its entire post-election rally, and even Wednesday's winners such as the iPhone maker turned lower. That Wednesday buying had been helped by falling oil prices, while the Windows maker jumped 6% to a record high.

Friday brought a partial rebound. Yahoo Finance reported on November 6 that the US added 165,000 jobs in October, and the Nasdaq gained 1.9% while the S&P 500 rose 1% and the Dow added 0.1%. For a closer look at one of the biggest AI spenders caught in the sell-off, we recently covered why the search giant's low price-to-earnings ratio can mislead . The stronger jobs data lifted Treasury yields and kept Federal Reserve policy at the center of market attention, Reuters reported on November 6, as the price-weighted index of 30 major US companies held roughly flat.

We shared the expanded list of the 10 Best Dow Stocks to Buy for 2027 . You can see the top 5 stocks below.

For this article, we used Finviz to screen Dow Jones Industrial Average components for stocks rated Buy or better by analysts, with an average price target at least 10% above the current price. We then ranked them by average upside potential, based on analysts' average price target, in ascending order. We also list short interest and the number of hedge fund holders as of Q2 2026.

Note: All data was sourced on November 6, 2026.

Salesforce is showing that its AI products are becoming a business of their own. Agentforce annual recurring revenue topped $1.5 billion in the fiscal second quarter, up more than 240% from a year earlier, and bookings for its premium Agentforce editions more than doubled from the prior quarter.

That momentum is lifting the core. Current remaining performance obligation, a gauge of contracted revenue, grew 14% in constant currency, and the company raised its full-year revenue outlook, citing organic strength in Agentforce, Data 360 and Slack. Free cash flow rose 81% in the quarter, which shows the AI push is not coming at the expense of cash generation.

Partnerships widen the reach. Salesforce announced Claudeforce, a planned Anthropic partnership that brings Claude into its data, applications and workflows. Management also said the number of customer accounts with agents in production grew sharply from the previous quarter, a sign that adoption is moving beyond pilot projects. Slack also delivered its fastest quarterly growth in net new annual order value since Salesforce acquired it, giving the AI push a workplace channel beyond sales and service.

Our analysis on Salesforce (NYSE:CRM) can be found here: Salesforce (CRM) Trails the Market in 2026: What Could Fuel a Re-Rating?

Alphabet's third-quarter report put the AI payoff on display, even as it spooked investors. Google Cloud revenue more than doubled, rising 103%, while the unit's operating margin widened to 36.2%, showing that the growth is profitable even at this scale.

A cloud backlog of $561 billion gives that growth runway, with just over half of it expected to turn into revenue over the next two years. Demand is broadening too. Chief Executive Sundar Pichai said the Gemini app has reached 1 billion users, which he called the fastest-growing product in Google's history.

The worry is spending. Capital expenditures keep climbing, and free cash flow turned negative in the quarter, which weighed on the stock. Bulls counter that operating income still grew strongly and that the earnings miss traced to an unrealized loss on the company's SpaceX stake, not to the core business. Search, the largest business, also kept growing, with Pichai saying AI is lifting query volume, including commercial queries. Management expects capital spending to rise significantly next year, so the bull argument rests on cloud contracts converting into revenue on schedule.

Our analysis on Alphabet (NASDAQ:GOOGL) is available here: Alphabet (GOOGL): Does Its Valuation Account for Waymo's Potential?

Cisco is turning AI data center spending into hard orders. Hyperscalers placed $9.3 billion of AI infrastructure orders with the company in fiscal 2026, several times the prior year's level, and management expects those customers to generate $7.5 billion of AI infrastructure revenue in fiscal 2027.

chineseContent:
雅虎财经11月5日报道称，道琼斯工业平均指数下跌3.4%，跌幅超过1800点，标准普尔500指数下跌4.4%，纳斯达克综合指数下跌5.5%，进入调整区间。芯片股首当其冲，其中人工智能芯片设计商和内存制造商受到的打击最为严重。雅虎财经 11 月 4 日写道，此次下滑抹去了前一天的涨幅，当时道琼斯指数在民主党赢得国会参众两院控制权后上涨了 3%，创下 2026 年最好的交易日。该媒体指出，到周四中午，该指数正走向自 1896 年中期选举以来数据最差的第二天。

在本周的大部分时间里，道琼斯指数看起来就像是市场的避风港。雅虎财经 11 月 2 日报道称，道指小幅上涨 0.4%，而纳斯达克指数下跌约 1%，因为投资者从科技股转向消费周期股和金融服务股，这使得道琼斯指数看起来像是市场的相对赢家。周四，随着焦点转向民主党国会对人工智能建设，特别是对推动人工智能建设的数据中心意味着什么，这种缓冲已经消失了。您可能还有兴趣阅读我们关于人工智能芯片领导者的增长与云软件巨头的增长比较的文章。

逆转来得又快又猛烈。股票研究公司首席市场策略师Shay Boloor指出，VIX波动率指数创下两年多来最大单日涨幅。周四，纳斯达克指数仅用了六分钟的时间就抹去了选举后的全部涨幅，甚至连 iPhone 制造商等周三的赢家也纷纷走低。周三的买盘得益于油价下跌，而这家 Windows 制造商股价上涨 6%，创历史新高。

周五带来部分反弹。雅虎财经11月6日报道，美国10月新增就业岗位16.5万个，纳斯达克指数上涨1.9%，标普500指数上涨1%，道指上涨0.1%。为了更仔细地了解陷入抛售的最大人工智能支出者之一，我们最近讨论了为什么这家搜索巨头的低市盈率会产生误导。据路透社 11 月 6 日报道，强劲的就业数据提振了美国国债收益率，并使美联储政策成为市场关注的焦点，美国 30 家主要公司的价格加权指数大致持平。

我们分享了 2027 年道琼斯指数最佳买入 10 只股票的扩展名单。您可以在下面看到排名前 5 的股票。

在本文中，我们使用 Finviz 筛选道琼斯工业平均指数成分股，寻找分析师评级为“买入”或更高的股票，平均目标价至少比当前价格高 10%。然后，我们根据分析师的平均价格目标，按平均上涨潜力按升序对它们进行排名。我们还列出了截至 2026 年第二季度的空头利息和对冲基金持有者数量。

注：所有数据均来源于 2026 年 11 月 6 日。

Salesforce 表明，其人工智能产品正在成为自己的业务。 Agentforce 第二财季的年度经常性收入超过 15 亿美元，同比增长超过 240%，其高级 Agentforce 版本的预订量比上一季度增加了一倍多。

这种势头正在提升核心。当前剩余履约义务（衡量合同收入的指标）按固定汇率计算增长了 14%，并且该公司提高了全年收入预期，理由是 Agentforce、Data 360 和 Slack 的有机实力。本季度自由现金流增长了 81%，这表明人工智能的推动不会以牺牲现金生成为代价。

合作伙伴关系扩大了影响范围。 Salesforce 宣布了 Claudeforce，这是一项计划中的 Anthropic 合作伙伴关系，将 Claude 引入其数据、应用程序和工作流程。管理层还表示，生产中代理的客户账户数量较上一季度大幅增长，这表明采用已经超出了试点项目的范围。自 Salesforce 收购 Slack 以来，Slack 的年度净新订单价值也实现了最快的季度增长，为人工智能的推动提供了销售和服务之外的工作场所渠道。

我们对 Salesforce (NYSE:CRM) 的分析可以在这里找到：Salesforce (CRM) 2026 年落后市场：什么会推动重新评级？

Alphabet 的第三季度报告展示了人工智能的回报，尽管它吓坏了投资者。谷歌云收入增长了一倍多，增长 103%，而该部门的营业利润率扩大至 36.2%，这表明即使在这种规模下，增长也是有利可图的。

5610 亿美元的云积压订单为这一增长提供了跑道，其中一半多一点预计将在未来两年内转化为收入。需求也在扩大。首席执行官桑达尔·皮查伊 (Sundar Pichai) 表示，Gemini 应用程序已拥有 10 亿用户，他称其为谷歌历史上增长最快的产品。

担心的是支出。资本支出持续攀升，本季度自由现金流转为负值，令该股承压。看多者反驳说，营业收入仍然强劲增长，盈利不及预期是由于该公司所持 SpaceX 股份的未实现损失，而不是核心业务。最大的业务搜索也在持续增长，皮查伊表示人工智能正在提升查询量，包括商业查询。管理层预计明年资本支出将大幅增加，因此看涨论点取决于云合同能否按计划转化为收入。

我们对 Alphabet （纳斯达克股票代码：GOOGL）的分析可在此处查看：Alphabet (GOOGL)：其估值是否反映了 Waymo 的潜力？

思科正在将人工智能数据中心支出转变为硬订单。超大规模企业在 2026 财年向该公司下了 93 亿美元的人工智能基础设施订单，是上一年水平的几倍，管理层预计这些客户将在 2027 财年产生 75 亿美元的人工智能基础设施收入。

这种力量并不局限于最大的云买家。第四财季网络产品订单增长 40%，连续第八个季度实现两位数增长，而更新的 Wi-Fi 7 和安全产品则扩大了产品范围。志
